summary: The portal uses an embedded PostgreSQL by default; for production use an external PostgreSQL 13+. Create the database and user (CREATE DATABASE rhdh_production, CREATE USER rhdh_user, GRANT ALL, ALTER OWNER) and test connectivity from the cluster with oc run postgres-test --image=postgres:13 ... psql.
questions: Can self-service automation portal use an external PostgreSQL?
